query:
SELECT 
  id, 
  name, 
  region,
  LENGTH(conservation_efforts) as conservation_length,
  LENGTH(sustainable_alternatives) as alternatives_length
FROM geographic_zones
WHERE id IN (30003, 3, 30005, 30006, 8, 30004, 30007)
ORDER BY id;
